dogecoin.text:
Still no whitepaper.
Still no supply cap.
Still hilarious.

Dogecoin proves that not all revolutions wear suits.

Sometimes all it takes is a dog, a joke, and the internet.

🔁 RT if you’ve ever whispered:

> “Wow. Much coin. Very moon.” 🐾

7. TL;DR — Dogecoin is absurdly iconic

🐶 Started as a joke

🤡 Trolled crypto hype

💬 Meme-powered by Reddit & Twitter

🤝 Backed (loudly) by Elon

💸 Used for real-world impact

🌌 Went to space

6. Dogecoin literally went to space 🌕

In 2021, SpaceX announced the DOGE-1 mission:

🛰 A satellite…
📡 Paid for in DOGE…
🚀 Headed to the actual moon.

That’s right: the joke left Earth.

5. Then Elon entered the chat

In 2020–2021, Elon Musk started tweeting:

> “Dogecoin is the people’s crypto”
“No highs, no lows, only Doge”

And every tweet? 🚀
DOGE exploded — reaching $0.73 from less than a penny.

The meme was now moon-bound.

3. But the internet did what the internet does

Reddit. Twitter. Chaos.

People LOVED it.
Because it didn’t take itself seriously.

✅ Cheap
✅ Funny
✅ Meme-powered

Dogecoin became the people’s coin — goofy, chaotic, and kind of lovable.

2. Created as a joke 😂

Jackson Palmer (Adobe) & Billy Markus (IBM dev) were trolling.

Bitcoin forks were everywhere.
Everyone was launching coins.
So they made Dogecoin — proudly useless.

It was a parody coin.
Until it wasn’t.

1. It all started with a meme dog

The Shiba Inu from the “Doge” meme — you know, the one with Comic Sans captions like:

> “wow”
“much coin”
“so crypto”

That was the face of Dogecoin. It launched in December 2013.

🧵 THREAD: THE JOKE THAT ACCIDENTALLY BECAME A BILLION-DOLLAR COIN 🐶💰

Dogecoin was created as a joke.
It was meant to mock the hype around crypto.

But then… it became real.
It got Elon’s attention. Went to the moon. Was literally used in space.
